purpose: Prove PayPlus callback semantics from real sandbox observations before any live paid/refund state is accepted.

proof_matrix.pass_when: at least one sandbox observation has signature_verified=true and ipn_full_verified=true
sandbox observation charge_method=1 with signature+IPN verified and a stable provider_status/provider_code fingerprint explicitly classified as paid-success from sandbox evidence
sandbox failure callback with signature+IPN verified and a stable provider_status/provider_code fingerprint explicitly classified as not-paid
replay of the same provider_event_id produces one durable payment event/observation and no duplicate paid transition
mismatched payment_request_uid, transaction_uid, more_info/session id, amount or currency is rejected
cancel/abandon path never creates paid state or real order
charge_method=4 sandbox/refund evidence is linked to original transaction and never classified as new revenue

observation_acceptance_rule: No provider_status/provider_code combination may be classified as paid-success or refund-success until that exact fingerprint has been observed in PayPlus staging with signature_verified=true and ipn_full_verified=true.
hard_rules: Never infer payment success from redirect URL alone.
Never infer payment success from charge_method=1 alone.
Never classify unknown provider_status/provider_code as paid.
Never mutate hunt_payplus_callback_accept_paid from this proof layer.
Never mutate hunt_supplier_order_live from this proof layer.
Live payment and supplier fulfillment remain OFF until separate Owner activation after proof.
